item.text: The client currently treats accounts differently: only `ops` follows cursors on short pages, and it retries those pages at twice the limit. For `treasury`, a short page ends the loop even when it includes `next_cursor`. I’m changing pagination to follow the feed’s cursor for every account and adding coverage for a short middle page.

Fixed pagination so every account follows `next_cursor`, even when a page contains fewer rows than the requested limit. Removed the `ops`-only retry at double page size.

Added regression coverage for both `treasury` and `ops` with a short page followed by another cursor. `python -m pytest -q` passes: **7 passed**.
